stem:
Each side of the regular hexagon ABCDEF is 10 cm long. What is the length of the diagonal AC?

[Image: Regular hexagon ABCDEF with diagonal AC]
figure_description: A regular hexagon ABCDEF is shown with vertices labeled clockwise from left: A (leftmost), B (top-left), C (top-right), D (rightmost), E (bottom-right), and F (bottom-left). Sides BC and FE are horizontal. A straight line segment connects vertex A and vertex C, representing diagonal AC.
